description: This file defines the ModifyAclStrategy class, which handles the command to modify the access control list (ACL) of a 'Thing' in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It validates the new ACL, creates and returns appropriate result objects and events, and manages entity tags relevant for concurrency control.

classes.name: ModifyAclStrategy
classes.description: A strategy class that handles modifying the ACL (Access Control List) of a 'Thing' object, validating the new ACL, producing events and responses, and managing entity tags for concurrency checks.

methods.name: doApply
methods.description: Executes the command to modify the ACL, validates the new ACL, creates an ACL modified event, and constructs the response and result.

methods.name: previousEntityTag
methods.description: Retrieves the EntityTag from the previous 'Thing' entity for concurrency control.

methods.name: nextEntityTag
methods.description: Retrieves the EntityTag from the new 'Thing' entity after modification for concurrency control.
